Recommended Action

Goals
Focus Area 4.1
2.1 Focus Area
1.1 Focus Area

DESCRIPTION:  The California Department of Education requires each Special Education Local Plan Area (SELPA) to submit its Annual Service and Budget Plan to its Board of Education for approval and adoption annually.  California Education Code Section 56195.9 (b) requires the submission of the Governance and Administration Plan at least once every three years and update as needed to ensure information contained within the plan remains relevant and accurate.  This public hearing enables the Orange SELPA to comply.
